page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9ae.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 9T95 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.25 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance configuration does not include local storage, requiring the attachment of external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this server type.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a compute-optimized resource. This hardware profile is designed for workloads that require high parallel processing capabilities without massive memory footprints. Appropriate use cases include batch processing, high-performance computing workloads, video encoding, and compute-heavy web serving.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9ae.32xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 9T95 processors running at 2.25 GHz, paired with 256.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps and does not include local storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Lacking integrated GPUs, the instance relies entirely on its high-core-count CPU architecture for processing. The qualitative resource profile makes this instance suitable for compute-intensive tasks such as parallel batch processing, distributed analytics, and high-performance computing workloads that do not require local storage or high memory-to-CPU ratios.
